We’re looking for people who like to build, take ownership, and figure things out on their own.

jobs.title: Web Development Intern
jobs.description:
Web Development Intern
Company:
Dexter's Tech
Location:
Remote
Duration:
3 Months
Application Deadline:
25th August 2026

For College Students Only!

About Dexter's Tech
Dexter's Tech provides students and graduates with practical exposure to modern web development through real-world projects and industry mentorship. The program is designed to help aspiring developers build technical expertise, strengthen problem-solving skills, and gain experience with industry-standard tools and technologies.
Roles & Responsibilities

Develop and maintain responsive, user-friendly websites and web applications.
Build interactive front-end interfaces using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
Assist in developing back-end functionalities and APIs.
Debug, test, and optimize applications for performance and scalability.
Collaborate with UI/UX designers to implement responsive designs.
Work with version control systems such as Git and GitHub.
Participate in code reviews and follow industry best practices.
Collaborate with the development team on live client and internal projects.

Requirements

Enrolled in or recently graduated from Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a related field.
Strong understanding of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
Familiarity with responsive web design principles.
Basic knowledge of React, Angular, Vue.js, or similar front-end frameworks (preferred).
Basic understanding of Node.js, Express.js, PHP, or Python back-end development (preferred).
Familiarity with Git/GitHub and basic database concepts (MySQL or MongoDB) is an advantage.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and debugging skills.
Excellent communication skills and the ability to work independently and collaboratively.

What You Will Gain

Hands-on experience working on live web development projects.
Swags and goodies.
Certificate of Internship upon successful completion.
Letter of Recommendation based on performance.
Opportunity to build a strong portfolio with real-world web applications.
Learn modern development tools, frameworks, and industry best practices.
Mentorship from experienced developers.
Potential full-time role based on performance.
Performance-Based Stipend up to ₹7,500/month.

How to Apply

Submit your application with the subject line:
"Web Development Intern Application – Dexter's Tech"

Equal Opportunity Statement
Dexter's Tech
is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes applicants from all backgrounds. We are committed to fostering diversity, inclusion, innovation, and professional growth for every intern.

jobs.title: Full Stack Web Development Intern
jobs.description:
FULL STACK WEB DEVELOPMENT INTERN (REMOTE) – AUGUST 2026 Company:
Future Interns
Location:
Remote (India)
Job Type:
Internship (Unpaid)
Duration:
1 Month
Start Date:
August 2026
About Future Interns Future Interns offers structured remote internship opportunities designed to help students and recent graduates apply their technical knowledge in a collaborative work environment. Our internship initiatives focus on providing practical project experience, professional guidance, and opportunities to contribute to meaningful assignments while working alongside mentors and peers.
Role Overview Future Interns is seeking enthusiastic and motivated Full Stack Web Development Interns
for the August 2026 internship cycle.
As a Full Stack Web Development Intern, you will contribute to the development and maintenance of web applications while supporting different phases of the software development lifecycle. This internship is suited to candidates who enjoy problem-solving, learning modern development practices, and collaborating within a remote development team.
Key Responsibilities • Assist in developing responsive web applications using modern web technologies.
• Support frontend implementation using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and related frameworks.
• Contribute to backend development tasks using technologies such as Node.js or Python.
• Work with relational or NoSQL databases including MySQL or MongoDB.
• Participate in debugging, testing, and application improvement activities.
• Maintain technical documentation related to assigned work.
• Collaborate with mentors and project teams during development activities.
• Follow coding standards, documentation practices, and version control workflows.
Required Qualifications • Basic understanding of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
• Familiarity with web development concepts and application architecture.
• Good analytical and problem-solving abilities.
• Effective written and verbal communication skills.
• Ability to work independently in a remote environment.
Preferred Qualifications • Familiarity with React, Node.js, Express.js, Python, MySQL, or MongoDB.
• Exposure to Git or other version control systems.
• Academic or personal web development projects are an advantage.
Internship Details Work Mode: Remote
Duration: 1 Month
Internship Type: Unpaid
Start Date: August 2026
Additional Information Throughout the internship, interns will receive guidance on assigned work and participate in collaborative project activities. Upon successful completion of the internship requirements, eligible interns may receive an Internship Completion Certificate. Performance-based recommendations may be considered in accordance with the organization's evaluation process.
Application Process Interested candidates may submit their application through the LinkedIn application process.
Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis, and shortlisted candidates will be contacted regarding the next steps.
